chief_complaint: Chronic kidney disease stage 4 with evaluation for kidney transplantation
history_of_present_illness: The patient has a long-standing history of type 2 diabetes mellitus complicated by progressive diabetic nephropathy. Kidney disease was first documented in 1993 (stage 1) and has advanced through stages 2, 3, and now stage 4 as of 2014, with an eGFR in the 15‑29 mL/min/1.73m2 range, prompting placement on the transplant list in 2014. Concurrent comorbidities include essential hypertension (diagnosed 1980), hyperlipidemia, obesity (BMI >30 since 1994), and obstructive sleep apnea diagnosed in 2009. The patient also has CKD‑related anemia diagnosed in 2014. Socially, he reports limited social contact and unsatisfactory housing, though he maintains full‑time employment and has higher education. The medication list is sparse, lacking antidiabetic agents, erythropoiesis‑stimulating agents, and appropriate CKD‑related therapies. The most recent encounter in the record is May 2016.
